chapters.title: Grant of Approval for Establishment of a New Technical Institution
mandatoryDocuments: Structural Stability Certificate by Chartered Engineer
Fire Safety Department No Objection Certificate (NOC)
University Letter of Intent / Affiliation NOC

chapters.title: Grant of Extension of Approval (EoA)
mandatoryDocuments: Continuation of Affiliation Order from University

chapters.title: Collaboration & Joint Degrees (Twinning & Dual Degree)
mandatoryDocuments: Bilateral MoU Agreement with Credit Transfer Clause
Association of Indian Universities (AIU) Equivalence Certificate
NAAC A+ or NBA Tier-1 Accreditation Order

chapters.title: Increase in Intake and Additional Programs
mandatoryDocuments: NBA Program Accreditation Certificate (Min 50% eligible courses)
Chartered Architect Built-Up Area Expansion Certificate
